name: Louise Ploa
source:
A demon summoned as a familiar to a formidable sentient aspect, she demands Judar give one of the demon stones in his possession to her. Whimsical and with a speech pattern akin to a scatter-brained high school student, she nonetheless has considerable combat prowess should Judar refuse her demands.

[Spoiler] If Judar gives in to her demands and gives her a demon stone on both occasions they meet with each other, she is gifted to him by the sentient spirit and can be sold to Lucilla's brothel. If Judar refuses and he defeats her in combat, she is also sold to Lucilla's brothel. [/Spoiler]
